newsitem.title: USA: EDnet says names Charles Erickson CEO.
newsitem.headline: EDnet says names Charles Erickson CEO.

text.p: EDnet Inc said Friday it has named Charles Erickson chief executive officer, president and a member of its board of directors.
The company said Erickson will be working with chairman of board and EDnet founder, Tom Kobayashi, who previously was chief executive officer.
The company said that before joining EDnet, Erickson spent over six years with AssureNet Pathways Inc, where he was president and chief executive officer.
The company also said it has begun preliminary discussions with several potential partners as merger candidates.
The company was not immediately able to provide further details.
